description: This file defines the IBasketService interface which specifies methods for managing shopping baskets, including adding items, setting quantities, transferring, and deleting baskets in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: Interface for basket-related operations such as adding items, setting quantities, transferring, and deleting baskets.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous ID to a user name.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket with a specified catalog item ID, price, and quantity.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for items in a basket, identified by basket ID and a dictionary mapping item IDs to quantities.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID.
